ann.t: Outcome of Board Meeting — Jindal Stainless Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
General Updates — Jindal Stainless Limited has informed the Exchange about full redemption of NCDs.

Updates — Jindal Stainless Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure pursuant to Chapter XIV-Centralized Database for corporate bonds/ debentures of SEBI Circular No: SEBI/HO/DDHS/DDHS-PoD/P/CIR/2025/0000000137 dated October 15, 2025'.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Jindal Stainless Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended Jun 30, 2026.
Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP — Jindal Stainless Limited has informed the Exchange about Resignation of Director/KMP/SMP
Cessation — Jindal Stainless Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Mr Tarun Kumar Khulbe as Chief Financial Officer of the company w.e.f. Jun 25, 2026.
Resignation — Jindal Stainless Limited has informed the Exchange regarding relinquishment of additional responsibility of CFO by Mr. Tarun Kumar Khulbe w.e.f. Jun 25, 2026.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Jindal Stainless Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended March 31, 2026.

Updates — Jindal Stainless Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Disclosure in terms of the Chapter XIV - Centralized Database for corporate bonds/ debentures of SEBI Master Circular no. SEBI/HO/DDHS/DDHS-PoD/P/CIR/2025/0000000137 dated October 15, 2025 ( SEBI Master Circular )'.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Jindal Stainless Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended December 31, 2025.

Cessation — Jindal Stainless Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Cessation of Mrs Arti Luniya as Non- Executive Independent Director of the company after closure of business hours of November 25, 2025.
Outcome of Board Meeting — Jindal Stainless Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2025.
